notes.title: Moped, Smoke and Leaning
notes.content:
New Vehicle: Viper Moped
The long-awaited Viper moped is here!
You’ll find it waiting for you in the PAVN Camp — perfect for rapid insertions or joyrides through the jungle. Keep in mind this is our first Land Vehicle and very much Work in Progress!
[hr][/hr]Leaning Mechanic (Q + E)
You can now lean left and right using Q and E — but only while aiming.

This is a big step toward more tactical, immersive infantry combat.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/d128b0f7d6ae479f244b31388bc2b81f730eb3ee.gif"]

[hr][/hr]Smoke Grenades
Smoke grenades have arrived!

Duration: 60 seconds

Loadouts: Look for Assault | Smoke and Sniper | Smoke
(Tip: Yes, the loadout list is scrollable!)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/b18e975fe6c67687052eb7e2d7d119e5de4877e0.gif"]
[hr][/hr]Improved Helicopter Flight Physics
Flying choppers is now smoother and more intuitive — we’ve reduced the required angle of attack for directional movement, resulting in more responsive and enjoyable controls.

notes.title: Engine Update, Optimisation and AA Gun
notes.content:
What's new this week?,New Unreal Engine version,
We have updated the demo to Unreal Engine version 5.6. This will give us better game performance and new tools to create better and more believable worlds. This update should also alleviate some of the issues we have been seeing with AMD cards, please let us know if you still are having issues playing with any AMD GPU.
Ping system,
You can now call out targets to your squad members by pressing middle mouse button, this places a temporary marker that only your squad members can see.
ZU-23 Anti-Aircraft gun,
A deadly tool for the PAVN forces to deal with enemy helicopters.
Frontlines gamemode,
This is a classic Attack/Defend gamemode. One team (PAVN) holds all the flags at the start of the round, while the other team (USA) have to attack and capture all flags to win. Defenders win by holding at least one flag until the round timer runs out, and the attackers win by capturing all flags. The capture order of the flags are linear, so make sure you only attack or defend the flag that is currently active (no lock icon on it)
Bugfixes,
We have worked hard to get rid of as many troublesome bugs as possible.
